name: Settings
theme: Neutral / Silver — calm control, precision, trust
human_question: How should NayaNET work for me?

five_layers.orientation: Settings category, account/identity and current scope
five_layers.state: actual account/runtime/local preference states with enforcement boundary visible
five_layers.intelligence: Naya explains consequences and the difference between local preference, account setting and governed policy

acceptance: human can find setting by human language
System Health is accessible but secondary
no local control misrepresented as server guarantee
